response.sql: WITH grouped_scans AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) AS total_gbsize, SUM(s.spanmin) AS total_spanmin, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM grouped_scans) SELECT gs.arcref, gs.fundflux, gs.rate, gs.rate - b.avg_rate AS excess FROM grouped_scans gs CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gs.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All groups (scans grouped by arcref and fundflux) have non-zero total spanmin to avoid division by zero when computing the rate
